outcome: Diagnosis of endometriosis by fine needle aspiration
cohort: Seven patients with a chief complaint of pain associated with an abdominal wall or pelvic mass, occurring in a setting of prior pelvic surgery.
finding: Fine needle aspiration cytology can be used to diagnose endometriosis in patients with a history of pelvic surgery and a palpable mass.
mod_finding: The most common previous surgery in the patients with endometriosis was Cesarean section (n = 6).
